summary: purestorage.flasharray assumes all Fusion fleet members run the same Purity//FA version as the connected array, and FlashArray//CBS isn't supported as a fleet member.
questions: Does purestorage.flasharray support Cloud Block Store in a Fusion fleet?
Does Ansible handle mixed Purity versions in a Fusion fleet?

answer_card.title: purestorage.flasharray Fusion fleet limitations
answer_card.answer_md:
- All Fusion fleet members are assumed to run the **same Purity//FA version** as the array Ansible connects to.
- **FlashArray//CBS** is not supported as a Fusion fleet member.
